subject: Tufts and Boston Avenue Rezoning Proposal
overview: City officials and consultants hosted a public information session to present preliminary research and gather community feedback on proposed rezoning for Boston Avenue and the Tufts University institutional area. Residents raised concerns regarding building heights, tree loss, shadow impacts, neighborhood buffering, and meeting notification.

items.title: Presentation on Boston Avenue and Tufts Rezoning Proposals
items.summary: City Councilor Matt Leming, planning director Alicia Hunt, and consultants Emily Innes and Paula Ramos-Martinez presented preliminary research, non-conformity analysis, and proposed zoning boundaries for Boston Avenue and the Tufts University campus.

items.title: Public Comment on Zoning Proposals and Neighborhood Impacts
items.summary: Attendees and online participants raised concerns regarding building heights, loss of green space, traffic, commercial mix, and Dover Amendment regulations, while city staff and consultants answered questions on zoning mechanics.

items.title: Update on Boston Avenue Community Advisory Group
items.summary: Rocco DiRico provided an update on the university-funded Boston Avenue planning study and community advisory group working to recommend streetscape and corridor improvements by the end of the year.

items.title: Next Steps and Upcoming Meetings
items.summary: Councilor Leming outlined the project timeline, noting an upcoming Planning and Permitting Committee meeting on May 5 and the next community meeting scheduled for June 1.
